notes: This contract records portable C++ and Java TCK witnesses for the IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.13.5 secure WebSocket over TLS 1.3 requirement. The scenarios use the official C++ or Java API. The adapter supplies a secure-WebSocket RTI Address and TLS trust settings; wss:// is this adapter profile's URI convention and is not asserted to be prescribed by the standard. The cases connect and complete List Federation Executions with its report callback. They do not establish certificate-policy edge cases or provider-wide conformance.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador::connect using an adapter-configured secure-WebSocket RtiConfiguration RTI Address, followed by List Federation Executions and its report callback
